One note for accuracy: my first attempt ran in managed-foreground mode with a 40s timeout I set, which is shorter than the 75s sleep, so that invocation was killed before it reached the echo or `exit 3` and produced no exit status. The completed run is the backgrounded one (`task_id: bg_task-4`), which ran the command to completion.
